description: This file contains static classes defining configuration constants used throughout the PDFsharp library, such as floating-point formatting options and mathematical constants.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Holds string constants for floating-point formatting with different decimal places, used for precise numerical representation in PDF processing.

classes.name: Const
classes.description: Defines mathematical constants related to PDF rendering, such as degree-to-radian conversion, angle sine, bold emphasis factor, and the kappa factor for Bézier curves.

methods.name: Math.PI
methods.description: Represents the mathematical constant π used in various calculations.

methods.name: Math.Sin
methods.description: Computes the sine of a given angle in radians.

methods.name: Math.Tan
methods.description: Computes the tangent of a given angle in radians.
